Attached: 1 image

Memos v0.31.0 is out, bringing major features to the open-source note-taking app! 🚀

Highlights:
- Spaces: Invite members and collaborate in shared workspaces.
- New Views: Browse notes by month on a Calendar or explore location-tagged memos on a Map.
- Portability: Export/import between instances using the new Memos ZIP format.

Release: https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases/tag/v0.31.0
Run on PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=memos

#opensource #selfhosted
